newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firm after late rally.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firm after late rally.

text.p: A late rally pushed MGE spring wheat futures off their daily lows to close mostly higher, traders said.
The late rally in Minneapolis was done mostly on spillover strength from KCBT wheat, which closed broadly higher after buy stops were hit toward the close.
MGE spring wheat had spent the day trading mostly lower, although scale-down commercial buying helped limit losses.
MGE spring wheat closed one cent per bushel lower to 4-1/2 cents higher, with Dec up 2-3/4 cents at $4.20-1/4. March gained 4-1/2 cents to close at $3.77-3/4.
Traders said the market had shown a muted reaction to the EU's decision to grant rebates of 19.45 Ecus per tonne on 429,300 tonnes of free-market soft wheat, up from 18 Ecus the previous week.
Atwood-Peavey, LFG and Wilson Trading each bought around 500,000 March bushels. LFG sold around 800,000 March and CIS sold 700,000 March.
MGE barley futures closed steady to one cent per cwt higher, with Dec unchanged at $6.75. March did not trade.
